# Direction markers from Maid

Taken over unchanged from Maid (`osm-editor-kit/maid`, `packages/renderer/assets/direction`, commit a94b157). Do not edit them here; take a new copy from Maid instead.

Each file points east: left to right is the way's drawing direction. The TILDA box turns them to the selected way's first segment (`modules/ui/sections/tilda_bike_infra.ts`).

- `forward.svg`: `yes`, one way along the line
- `reversed.svg`: `-1`, one way against the line (the hook)
- `both.svg`: `no`, both directions
- `drawn.svg`: the line's drawing direction
